headline: Japan and US Carry Out Coordinated Intervention to Support Yen
summary: Japan and the United States carried out a coordinated yen-buying intervention in the currency market, as reported on Monday. The move follows the yen's weakness against the dollar.
why: The yen is a major funding and reserve currency, and intervention by Japanese authorities and the US Treasury can sharply shift yen exchange rates and carry-trade positioning.
why_moved: The report of a joint yen-buying intervention by Japan and the US, after the yen hit its weakest level in decades, is the direct driver of the currency move.
